verdict.rationale: Moneybird's own llms.txt describes an official MCP channel "for an AI chat" that connects to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or any MCP client, so users can operate it in natural language through an external AI client. The only evidence is two brief llms.txt lines, with no detail on which operations work or any hands-on proof. Missing for 10: documentation of which actions (invoicing, contacts, bookkeeping) are exposed via MCP, a native in-product natural-language interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Three channels on the same REST API: MCP for an AI chat, the CLI for the terminal, the API for your own software.
